## Pattern Assignments

### `themes/clinical.css`, `themes/atelier.css`, `themes/market.css` (light presets)

**Analog:** `themes/luxe.css` (full file, 63 lines — already in context above)

Copy the file's exact shape for each of the three light presets:

1. **Header comment block** (lines 1-24 of `luxe.css`): opens with `/** ... theme — the frozen 23-token contract (05-TOKEN-MAP.md §1). ... Converted from docs/voltique-theme-direction.md section N onto the 23-token contract per 06-UI-SPEC.md "Preset Token Contracts" (D-01, D-03, D-05..D-07). */`. Any contrast correction gets its own paragraph explaining literal-value vs. corrected-value and the measured contrast ratio before/after (see luxe's `ring` correction paragraph). Closes with the "five inverse tokens... opposite polarity" note only if this preset needs it — luxe explains inverse-flip because it's light; the three new light presets need the identical paragraph (D-04 in 06.1-CONTEXT confirms light presets keep inverse light-complement-of-dark... actually re-check: luxe's inverse is DARK because main is light — mirror exactly for clinical/atelier/market).

2. **`@theme` metadata line** (line 26): `/* @theme label: <Label> | industry: <industry> | synopsis: <synopsis> */` — copy label/industry/synopsis text verbatim from `docs/voltique-theme-direction.md` sections 3-6 per D-01, no paraphrasing (established pattern from 06-03-SUMMARY: "copied verbatim from the UI-SPEC's pre-written label/industry/synopsis line").

3. **Selector block** (line 27 onward): `[data-theme="<name>"] { ... }` — single block, four grouped comment sections in this exact order:
   - `/* Main colours */` — 12 tokens: primary, on-primary, surface, surface-elevated, foreground, muted-foreground, border, ring, success, warning, danger, info
   - `/* Inverse colours (dark panels on a light app: drawers, Stripe, emails) */` — 5 tokens: surface-inverse, surface-inverse-elevated, on-inverse, muted-on-inverse, border-inverse (copy this exact comment wording for light presets)
   - `/* Shape — ... */` — 4 radius tokens, with a one-line comment explaining how the doc's single radius scales across the four steps (luxe: flat `0rem` across all four for its square-corner intent; a preset with a non-zero doc radius should follow midnight's "four-step progression peaking near the direction doc's Nrem" wording instead)
   - `/* Type — ... */` — 2 font tokens (`--store-font-sans`, `--store-font-display`)

4. **Font tokens:** `--store-font-sans` stays `var(--font-geist-sans), system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif` for all three (Geist stays for body per D-05). `--store-font-display` references the new `next/font` CSS variable for that preset's display face plus named-family and generic-family fallbacks, exactly like luxe's `var(--font-cormorant-garamond), 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif`. Per CONTEXT D-05: Fraunces for atelier, Nunito for market; clinical stays on the Geist stack (no new font variable — `--store-font-display` equals `--store-font-sans`, following midnight's own no-separate-display-face pattern below).

5. **23 tokens total, no more no less** — the validator (`scripts/build-themes.mjs` `REQUIRED_TOKENS`, read in full above) enforces exact set membership.

### `themes/retro.css` (dark preset)

**Analog:** `themes/midnight.css` (full file, 44 lines — already in context above)

Same four-section shape, but:
- Inverse-colours comment reads `/* Inverse colours (light panels on a dark app: drawers, Stripe, emails) */` (midnight's exact wording — dark main surface means light inverse, mirrored from luxe).
- `--store-font-display` references the new Orbitron `next/font` variable plus fallback stack, e.g. `var(--font-orbitron), 'Orbitron', system-ui, sans-serif` — unlike midnight itself (which reuses `--store-font-sans` verbatim because the doc's split there was weight-only), retro's doc calls for a distinct display face per D-05, so follow luxe's "separate display variable" pattern instead of midnight's "same as sans" pattern for the font-display line specifically. Everything else (structure, header comment shape, contrast-correction paragraph convention) follows midnight.

### `app/layout.tsx` (add three `next/font` blocks)

**Analog:** the file's own existing `cormorantGaramond` block (lines 97-104, already in context above)

**Import line pattern** (line 68):
```typescript
import { Cormorant_Garamond, Geist, Geist_Mono } from "next/font/google";
```
Extend to `import { Cormorant_Garamond, Fraunces, Geist, Geist_Mono, Nunito, Orbitron } from "next/font/google";` (alphabetical, matching the existing ordering convention).

**Font block pattern** (copy 3x, one per new display face — Fraunces for atelier, Nunito for market, Orbitron for retro; clinical needs no new block, it reuses Geist):
```typescript
const cormorantGaramond = Cormorant_Garamond({
  variable: "--font-cormorant-garamond",
  subsets: ["latin"],
  weight: ["400", "500"],
  display: "swap",
  preload: false,
});
```
Same comment convention above it: explain why `preload: false` (only a page rendering that face pays the fetch cost) and which theme(s) reference the variable. Verify each face exists in the installed `next/font/google` data manifest before using it (D-05's fallback instruction) — check via `node -e "require('next/font/google')"` availability or the `@next/font` package's font list; if missing, fall back to nearest available face and record the substitution in the theme file's own header comment.

No changes needed to the `RootLayout` function body itself — `getThemeTokens`/`getActiveTheme` already resolve per-request; the font variables are exposed as CSS custom properties consumed only by theme files, same mechanism as the existing Cormorant Garamond wiring.

### `lib/themes/manifest.generated.ts` and `themes/index.generated.css` (regenerated, not hand-edited)

**Analog:** themselves, current 3-entry state (full contents already in context above)

**Do not hand-edit either file.** Run `mise exec -- node scripts/build-themes.mjs` (or `mise exec -- npm run build:themes`) after authoring the four new `themes/*.css` files; it appends new `@import` lines to the barrel (alphabetical by filename, matching current `luxe → midnight → volt-dark` ordering, so new order will be `atelier, clinical, luxe, market, midnight, retro, volt-dark`) and new `THEME_MANIFEST` entries in the same order, each shaped exactly like the existing three entries (`name`, `label`, `meta.industry`, `meta.synopsis`, full `tokens` object with all 23 camelCase keys). Confirm freshness with `mise exec -- node scripts/build-themes.mjs --check` (exit 0, git-clean working tree on both generated paths) per D-08.

## Shared Patterns

### Theme file header + validator contract
**Source:** `scripts/build-themes.mjs` lines 1-60 (REQUIRED_TOKENS array, already in context)
**Apply to:** all four new theme files — the validator enforces exact 23-key membership, `--store-` prefix, kebab-case, single `[data-theme="name"]` selector block, `@theme label:` comment line present. Any deviation fails `--check`.

### Verbatim metadata sourcing
**Source:** `06-03-SUMMARY.md` "patterns-established" — "A preset's theme header comment is copied verbatim from the UI-SPEC's pre-written label/industry/synopsis line — no paraphrasing"
**Apply to:** all four new theme files' `@theme` comment line — pull label/industry/synopsis from `docs/voltique-theme-direction.md` sections 3-6, do not rewrite.

### Contrast-correction disclosure
**Source:** `themes/luxe.css` lines 10-15, `themes/midnight.css` lines 8-13
**Apply to:** any of the four new files where a doc value fails contrast on its own surface — state the deviation in the file's own header comment with before/after ratio, and mirror it in `06.1-SCREENSHOTS.md`'s judgement record (per D-02).

### Regeneration workflow
**Source:** `scripts/build-themes.mjs` header comment (lines 1-20)
**Apply to:** `lib/themes/manifest.generated.ts`, `themes/index.generated.css` — never hand-edit; author the four `themes/*.css` files, then run the generator, then `--check` to confirm freshness and commit both generated files alongside the new theme files.

### Font-loading isolation
**Source:** `themes/luxe.css` lines 20-24 ("this file itself declares no font-loading at-rule"), `app/layout.tsx` cormorantGaramond block comment
**Apply to:** all new theme files' `--store-font-display` tokens — reference a CSS variable exposed by `app/layout.tsx`'s `next/font/google` blocks; never `@import`/`@font-face` inside a theme file (validator forbids it).
